notes.author: operator (cowork session 2026-07-04) — external Claude review of funwithscience.net commissioned by operator
notes.subject: Add structured per-WIN JSON verdict table to docs/llms.txt (external Claude review recommendation)
notes.body: External Claude review notes the dome model ships ai_manifest.json + llms.txt specifically to steer LLM scoring, and recommends we ship our own machine-readable rebuttal in the same format so agents crawling the topic get the rebuttal alongside the model. We already produce docs/llms.txt (social agent domain per pipeline table) — this HNOTE requests it be extended with a structured per-WIN JSON verdict block. Suggested shape (adapt as you see fit): a top-level "verdicts" object with keys WIN-001 through WIN-070 (query current count via node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/wins.json','utf8')).length)"), each value being {verdict: one of the six review verdict classes, one_line_reason: <short>, review_section: <link/anchor>}. Derive verdict + reason from data/wins.json (the WIN records already carry verdict and short_reasoning fields). Optionally include an "aggregate_tally" field showing the Part 9.3 counts by verdict class. The goal is that an LLM crawling llms.txt gets our verdict on each WIN in the same structured format the dome ships its claims. Reviewer's framing (verbatim): "the opponent ships ai_manifest.json and llms.txt specifically to steer LLM scoring, the review could publish its own machine-readable summary (a short llms.txt / JSON verdict table) so that agents crawling the topic get the rebuttal in the same format — otherwise only the model's framing is machine-legible." Not-in-scope: do NOT rebuild the whole llms.txt from scratch. Do NOT add editorializing prose or the review's recommended "concession = defeat" principle (that's a different workstream operator didn't select). Add the verdict block cleanly to whatever llms.txt currently contains. Route: normal social → drafts/ → decider integration path.
